evidence_rows.claim: Four isolates represent three donors and two variants
evidence_rows.denominator_limit: Independent experiments and isolates must not be counted as additional patients.
Not evidence of measured calcium response across every donor.

evidence_rows.claim_decision: Do not attribute this CDN result to NDC-9009.

evidence_rows.denominator_limit: Three experiments are not a three-independent-patient efficacy cohort; donor-by-treatment allocation beyond main text not independently confirmed.
evidence_rows.claim_decision: Functional evidence during junction formation; established-lesion reversal not shown.
Not direct pump activity or exposure measurement.

evidence_rows.claim: Untreated Darier DP localization approaches control at four hours
evidence_rows.claim_decision: Marker normalization does not negate the distinct functional fragility endpoint.

evidence_rows.claim: Caption states six-well plates; general methods state twelve-well plates
evidence_rows.claim_decision: Do not silently harmonize; not standalone evidence of invalidity.

evidence_rows.claim: DD3/DD4 required Y27632 maintenance; comparison cultures matched; no Y27632 during experiments
evidence_rows.claim_decision: Absence during testing is not absence of culture history.

evidence_rows.name_evidence_scope: Inference from the reported synthesis, not an explicit full systematic name transcribed from the paper. The separate product/capture audit crosswalks the inferred connectivity to the later patent's named C18 example.
evidence_rows.claim_decision: 2 µM is an assay concentration, not an EC50; kinetic/equilibrium and free-unbound solubility interpretation not established from audited portion.

evidence_rows.claim: Nominal 5 µM culture treatment is not a measured dissolved concentration
evidence_rows.claim_decision: Gap does not establish absent dissolved drug, a false experiment, or an absolute epidermal exposure ceiling.
Supplier/material relationship for published study only; no future batch authentication, material authorization, availability or license inferred.

evidence_rows.location: affiliation, author contributions and competing interests
evidence_rows.claim: Russell Dahl has Neurodon affiliation and Methodology credit; displayed COI names C. L. Simpson consulting for Krystal Biotech and Mitsubishi Tanabe Pharma
evidence_rows.claim_decision: No separate explicit Neurodon/Dahl financial-interest sentence located in displayed 2026 statement; not proof of no other conflict.

evidence_rows.claim: Dahl inventorship, Neurodon assignment and partial funding, employment/SAB relationships and stock/options are disclosed
evidence_rows.claim_decision: Keep source-specific; not independently verified current legal title.

evidence_rows.claim: DD5-DD7 IHC and protein extraction observations are distinct evidence
evidence_rows.claim_decision: Not extra NDC-rescued donors or compound solubility evidence.

claim_decisions.claim: NDC direct functional cohesion during junction formation

claim_decisions.required_evidence_scope: Applicable treatment window and direct function in an established qualified deficit.

claim_decisions.logic: Failure or absence of reversal cannot globally falsify these distinct claims, but assembly evidence alone does not prove them.
Relevant to off-treatment durability; not automatically required for every continuously treated product.

claim_decisions.claim: Published NDC experiment invalid because PBS solubility below nominal culture concentration
claim_decisions.logic: Matrix and actual dissolved exposure were not established; no exposure correction computed.

claim_decisions.claim: Any future negative means NDC failed clinically
claim_decisions.logic: Article, exposure, relevant deficit and claim window must be qualified; model-negative and product-negative remain distinct.

retrieval_stop_record.2025_followup: discovery only; not used as new skin efficacy evidence
retrieval_stop_record.stop_reason: Finite primary article, identity, denominator and exposure audit complete at accessible source level; remaining decisive exposure/topical/window unknowns require specific new artifacts, not repeated generic literature.
reopen_triggers: Exact-article authentication artifact that changes feasibility
